profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Salesforce
profile.summary:
I have experience in software engineering, research, teaching, consulting, providing technical support, owning two businesses, and in many other areas.

As a husband and a father of 6 kids, my goals are to successfully provide for my family and help others around me succeed.

Specialties: 
~Software engineering in TypeScript, Javascript, JAVA, Python, Golang, MATLAB, and more
~Software testing frameworks (xUnit Frameworks, Mocking Frameworks, Performance Frameworks, etc).
~Problem solving - primarily with mathematics and computation, simulation, and optimization algorithms.
~Lecturing and presenting in front of large groups.
~Collaborating with others to seek solutions.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Currently, I'm the Lead Engineer for Salesforce Agentic Developer Experience (ADX), I direct the strategy behind our next-generation developer tools. After architecting the core layers of Agentforce Vibes, our DX MCP Server, and other AI integrations, I now lead teams in building custom agent frameworks, SDKs, pipelines, and services that power the 'vibing' agentic experiences across the Salesforce Platform.

* Was lead engineer for the Salesforce Code Analyzer product, where I directed the efforts to rewrite the open-sourced Salesforce Code Analyzer product from the ground up with a new design and architecture. What was once a monolithic Salesforce CLI plugin, is now a well architected framework with pluggable engines allowing for flexible integration and complete customization for external users and internal teams alike. Additionally, I led the effort of implementing seven code analysis engines and a growing number of user-facing clients (CLI, VS Code Extension, GitHub Action, MCP tools, and internal microservices) on top of this framework. Development was primarily done with a test-driven development approach in Typescript, JavaScript, JAVA, and Python.

* Took over the lead position of the AppExchange App Analytics team where I architected a more robust strategy to move away from our big data processing approach to a more modern and scalable micro-event processing and delivery pipeline. After successfully piloted the new architecture, I then trained a new India based team to take over the product so that I could lead Salesforce Code Analyzer team full time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* My primary role was developing the platform behind AppExchange App Analytics, which uses a mixture of Salesforce, AWS infrastructure, and big data (Spark, HDFS) technologies to process and deliver telemetry data to ISV partners, enabling them to gain insights into how their subscribers are using their managed packages all around the world. Development was primarily done in JAVA, SQL, Python, GoLang, and Terraform HCL.
* Was able to scale our services and data lake to process over 15 billion events per day.
* Won the TMP All-Star Award in 2022 for my work in designing and implementing monitoring strategies for our processing jobs and pipelines across nearly a thousand salesforce instances across the globe.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer
positions.description:
* My primary role was developing data intensive applications with Google Cloud Platform primarily in the Go programming language (GoLang).
* As a member of the platform and integrations team, I contributed to Salesforce integrations and implementing webhooks that forward Pendo visitor driven events to Segment.com.
* Contributed to the redesign and implementation of backend services for mobile which enabled retrospective analytics for Android and iOS apps.
* Helped train associate engineers how to contribute to our backend systems and quickly ramp up to our fast-paced agile development workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Object Oriented Design · Test Automation · Software Engineering · Unit Testing · Programming · Testing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* My primary role was to lead and coordinate software development team efforts to bring long standing research and algorithm ideas into production.
* As tech lead, I developed processes, coding standards, development environments, build systems, continuous integration solutions, testing platforms, and deployment scripts which helped bring some of the programs surrounding Electronic Intelligence (ELINT) to scale.
* Designed and developed systems using a microservices architecture with RESTful endpoints where half of the microservices were developed with JAVA EE to interface with Northrop Grumman libraries and the other half were developed as Python Flask Apps for machine learning purposes.
* Contributed to existing R&D efforts in the Electronic Warfare division by studying data science techniques, developing algorithms for clustering and pattern recognition, and creating prototypes which automate intercept processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Object Oriented Design · Test Automation · Software Engineering · Unit Testing · Java · JUnit · Programming · Testing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Test Infrastructure & Architecture
positions.description:
* My primary role was to lead the effort in providing user interface enhancements to environments like the MATLAB Desktop and Live Editor to boost productivity and efficiency of testing workflows. This UI development was primarily done in JAVA, JavaScript, and MATLAB.
* Added extensibility into key areas of upstream components which, after years of being blocked, enabled downstream teams like our own to enhance MATLAB’s user interfaces independent of the dedicated UI team.
* Helped create and deliver presentations at the MathWorks Advisory Board conferences to collect feedback and requirements from major customers.
* Provided support, consulting, and training to the entire Development Organization in areas of automation, continuous integration, and testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Test Infrastructure & Architecture
positions.description:
* Helped create the MATLAB Unit Testing framework which ships as a core MATLAB feature to over a million customers.
* My primary role was designing and developing an extensible architecture with a public API for our qualification framework.
* Using S.O.L.I.D. software design principles, I also contributed to the development of a performance testing framework and a mocking framework to help our advanced MATLAB customers adopt modern testing practices.
* Created a plugin-based reporting mechanism for our test runners allowing users to view/store test results as HTML, PDF, and Word formats.

positions.title: Quality Engineer
positions.description:
* Acted as quality engineer for the Symbolic Math and Partial Differential Equation toolboxes and provided support for all MATLAB math toolboxes.
* Created and maintained test plans and test suites, found and diagnosed bugs, reviewed code, reviewed design documents and customer visible documentation, submitted enhancement requests, measured performance and memory usage, and improved/automated existing processes.
* Used advanced math and computer science techniques to develop and verify edge cases to best test our algorithms.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
* Offered web development, computer consulting, computer repair, computer networking services.
* Worked as a consultant for large businesses such as The UPS Store and ACCO Brands in Ogdensburg, NY.

positions.title: Instructor / Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•	Developed new curriculum for over six hundred students among eleven sections, lecturing on pre-calculus/calculus topics.
•	Lectured eight hours a week and managed two teaching assistants to lecture from my notes for the remaining sections.
•	Taught multiple recitations each semester for Calculus I, II, and III while working with faculty to improve courses.
•	Held five office hours a week and graded all tests and quizzes each semester.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
•	Started and managed self-owned computer business involving computer repairs, builds, upgrades, and web development.
•	Met individually with small businesses to set up finance, security, networking, and web solutions to improve productivity.
•	Installed military grade antennas, routers, and access points in order to provide an entire beach side resort wireless access.

volunteerExperiences.role: Director of Middle School Youth Group
volunteerExperiences.description: I am the director of the middle school youth group, where I enjoy leading the efforts towards equipping the next generation in loving God and one another through teachings, community volunteer events, and lots of fun activities. For Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these." - Matt 19:14

projects.title: Mathematical modeling, simulation, and optimal design for agricultural water management
projects.description:
The American Institute of Mathematics SQuaREs Event – Palo Alto, CA
•	Awarded an all expense paid trip to participate in a workshop with some of the top PhDs around the country to help solve the national water usage problems in agriculture. As the only graduate student invited, I am currently helping to implement ground water usage simulations in order to find optimal crop rotation strategies to minimize the agricultural water needs in the United States.

projects.title: Differential Inequalities & Maximum Principles
projects.description:
NC State REU in Modeling and Industrial Applied Mathematics – Raleigh, NC
•	Sharpened my teamwork skills as I worked in a research group studying positive feedback and population models using differential inequalities and maximum principles. Strengthened my abilities in analysis and numerically solving systems of ODEs and PDEs.
•	Developed and presented poster presentation at the NCSU Undergraduate Research Symposium. - July 30, 2009
